about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in Toyland? Explore 5 unique maps filled with handmade toy houses, blocks, plush animals, and colorful toys. Discover cats hiding in these scenes and color each one by numbers to bring this joyful world to life!

Each map reflects the warm and fun atmosphere of Toyland with detailed hand drawings. Can you find the cats hidden in this magical world?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Enjoy the colors and toys!

✨ Features:

🧸 5 unique Toyland maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed Toyland radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
